definition: Provides the transactions in the report.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

ProcessingStatus.name: Processing Status
ProcessingStatus.definition: Status and status reason of the transaction.

ProcessingStatusRule.definition: ProcessingStatus must be present or Cancellation(*)/ProcessingStatus must be present, but not both.

SafekeepingAccountRule.definition: SafekeepingAccount must be present or Cancellation(*)/SafekeepingAccount must be present, but not both.

AccountOwnerRule.definition: AccountOwner must be present or Cancellation(*)/AccountOwner must be present, but not both.
